user.description: Create a new matrix: give it a name, then add its rows and columns as labels.

data_description.name: A name for this matrix, e.g. "Climate Profiles".
data_description.rows: Row labels, e.g. "Comfort", "Eco", "Sleep" -- type a label and press Enter to add it.
data_description.columns: Column labels, e.g. "Living Room", "Office", "Bedroom" -- type a label and press Enter to add it.

error.rows_required: At least one row is required.
error.columns_required: At least one column is required.

init.description: Edit this matrix's rows and columns. A label not in the new list is removed (its data is discarded); a new label starts at null.

data_description.rows: Row labels, e.g. "Comfort", "Eco", "Sleep" -- type a label and press Enter to add it. A label not in this list is removed (its data is discarded); a new label starts at null.
data_description.columns: Column labels, e.g. "Living Room", "Office", "Bedroom" -- type a label and press Enter to add it. A label not in this list is removed (its data is discarded); a new label starts at null.

error.rows_required: At least one row is required.
error.columns_required: At least one column is required.

set_cell.name: Set cell
set_cell.description: Set (or clear) a single cell in a matrix.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new value. Omit to clear the cell.

set_row.name: Set row
set_row.description: Update one or more cells in a row.

values.name: Values
values.description: A mapping of column key to new value (or null to clear).

set_column.name: Set column
set_column.description: Update one or more cells in a column.

values.name: Values
values.description: A mapping of row key to new value (or null to clear).
